compare_blocks.body:
Taking talkative and fond of sprawling threads in a group chat as an ENTP marker is the common mismatch in this pair. E means attention and energy turn outward more often, not volume; INTJ may talk for half an hour about structural problems in front of people they trust, and ENTP may show nothing at all while a line of reasoning is still forming.

Taking cold and sparing with explanations as an INTJ trait is no more reliable. I means handling things inward more often, not refusing to communicate; ENTP unwilling to give a conclusion before thinking it through also looks like sparing with explanations. Judged by how much is said, either type can be misread.

Using a trial or a single transition does not establish competence. Evaluate a plan against its evidence, constraints and authorised review.

The fourth takes shared N and T as meaning the conclusions should agree. Both may value pattern and standard, but the specific judgement depends on information, experience and position; reaching opposite conclusions on one plan does not show that either is not N or not T.

**Scope limits**: MBTI describes emphasis of preference, not a prediction of ability, performance or relationship outcomes. Assessment results are not for ranking ability, hiring screens or predicting relationships; changes to production systems, contract signing and legal or financial decisions follow the organisation's process and qualified professionals. The FermatMind assessment uses a separate item bank and scoring, set out in the [scoring and evidence notes](/en/tests/mbti-personality-test-16-personality-types#method-and-evidence).

Use the individual profiles to explore the two differing preferences or see how Ne and Ni appear in type dynamics.

A/T further reading: this is the NERIS Identity dimension from 16Personalities, covering self-evaluation, self-assurance and response to pressure, not a fifth official MBTI dimension; A marks Assertive, T Turbulent. It is scored on a different frame from the four preferences compared here, is not used to explain the decision order of the two types, and promises no way of separating short-term pressure from a stable preference.

- [ENTP-A](/en/personality/entp-a) · [ENTP-T](/en/personality/entp-t) · [INTJ-A](/en/personality/intj-a) · [INTJ-T](/en/personality/intj-t)
